name: GREATEC
recent: 近期公告主要是 EPF 与董事的持股变动申报，以及董事在闭市期外的买卖。新闻方面，公司位于美国的新厂房（价值 7960 万美元）已投产，订单创下 4.5 亿美元新高。
notable: 公司美国新厂房（价值 7960 万美元）投产，订单创下 4.5 亿美元新高。
首席执行官兼执行董事 Dato' Seri Tan Eng Kee 于 10 月 15 日以每股 2.50 令吉增持 50,100 股。
非独立非执行董事 Khor Lean Heng 于 10 月 7 日以每股 2.82 令吉减持 200,000 股。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间连续多次申报持股变动。
非独立非执行董事 Khor Lean Heng 减持 200,000 股。
Bursa 20 大科技股市值蒸发 44.6 亿令吉。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 2.096 亿令吉，环比增长 17.1%，但同比下滑 9.9%；净利为 3358 万令吉，环比增长 24.8%，同比增长 29.5%；净利率为 16.0%，高于上一季度的 15.0%。

recent_en: Recent announcements were mainly EPF and director interest disclosures, plus director dealings outside closed period.
notable_en: Its new US plant (US$79.6m) is operational, with order book hitting a record US$450m.
CEO and Executive Director Dato' Seri Tan Eng Kee acquired 50,100 shares at MYR2.50 each on 15 Oct.
Non-Independent Non-Executive Director Khor Lean Heng disposed of 200,000 shares at MYR2.82 each on 7 Oct.
risks_en: EPF made multiple consecutive shareholding change disclosures from October to November.
Non-Independent Non-Executive Director Khor Lean Heng disposed of 200,000 shares.
Global AI-related tech stocks sold off, wiping RM4.46 bil off Bursa's 20 largest tech stocks.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR209.6m, up 17.1% QoQ but down 9.9% YoY; net income was MYR33.58m, up 24.8% QoQ and 29.5% YoY; net margin was 16.0% versus 15.0% in the prior quarter.
